title: Avoid constraint keyword case-conversion allocations
description: Replace CHECK prefix and keyword default matching case-conversion allocations with ASCII case-insensitive helpers.

criteria: CHECK prefix matching no longer allocates an uppercase string
Keyword default matching no longer allocates a lowercase string
ASCII case-insensitive behavior remains unchanged for CHECK, true, false, and null

notes: The CHECK helper compares the leading bytes against the ASCII keyword without constructing an uppercase String.
The default-value helper uses eq_ignore_ascii_case for true, false, and null.
Parsing, error handling, and fallback string behavior remain unchanged.
